data.title: bn-3mwz: current-child bindings and normalized runtime digest fix
data.description: run_rebaseline.py now expects set(SEMANTIC_CONFIG_DESTINATIONS) for current-child sandboxes, matching build_children.py's four reviewed config --ro-bind-data bindings. Cross-producer semantic runtime equality now uses evidence_schema.semantic_runtime_content_sha256 over retained manifest content, preserving strict equality across ASCII current-child and UTF-8 prepared-authority conventions while retaining raw per-authority self-consistency checks. Producer-faithful fixtures cover four-binding argv/FD counts and representation-split runtime digests. Both self-test suites, py_compile, and the real prepared-r7 two-module retain_prepared_semantic_manifests rehearsal pass.
